name: sales.customers
description: One row per customer. Columns: id, name, region, signup_date. Use for customer counts, regional customer lists, and new-signup trends. Join key: customers.id = orders.customer_id.

name: region
description: Customer's sales region: Europe, Asia, North America. To analyze revenue or orders by region, join sales.orders to sales.customers and GROUP BY customers.region.

name: signup_date
description: Date the customer account was created. Use for new-customer growth, cohort questions, and month-over-month signup trends.

name: sales.products
description: Product catalog: id, name, category, unit_price. Use for price lookups, category lists, and bestseller analysis. Join key: products.id = orders.product_id.

name: category
description: Product type: Hardware, Software, Services. Use for category revenue breakdowns and category performance comparisons.

name: sales.orders
description: One row per order line: customer_id, product_id, quantity, total_amount, status, order_date. Use for revenue, order volume, average order value, and sales trend questions. Join to customers for region and to products for category.

name: total_amount
description: Money value of the order. Use SUM(total_amount) for revenue, AVG for average order value, and it powers best-seller rankings.

name: status
description: Order lifecycle state: delivered, pending, cancelled. Revenue reports usually filter status = 'delivered'; cancelled is excluded from revenue.

name: order_date
description: Date the order was placed. Use for monthly/quarterly trends, year comparisons, and time-range filters like last quarter.

name: orders->customers
description: For region or customer-name sales questions, join sales.orders to sales.customers on orders.customer_id = customers.id, then GROUP BY customers.region or customers.name.

name: orders->products
description: For product or category sales questions, join sales.orders to sales.products on orders.product_id = products.id, then GROUP BY products.name or products.category.

name: average order value
description: Average Order Value = SUM(total_amount) / COUNT(*) over sales.orders, usually with status = 'delivered'. Compare across regions or months.
